intro.en: Two friends talk about a son joining university. Notice the verbs after «لَمْ» (lam): they end in a sukoon, like «لَمْ أَجِدْكَ» (I did not find you).
intro.ur: Do doston ki baat-cheet hai ke beta jamia mein daakhila le raha hai. Dhyan dein: «لَمْ» ke baad fe'l par sukoon aata hai, jaise «لَمْ أَجِدْكَ» (maine aap ko nahi paya).
intro.ar: يَتَحَدَّثُ صَديقانِ عَنِ التِحاقِ ابْنٍ بِالجامِعَةِ. لاحِظْ أَنَّ الفِعْلَ بَعْدَ «لَمْ» يَنْتَهي بِسُكونٍ، مِثْلَ «لَمْ أَجِدْكَ».

dialogue.ar: زُرْتُكَ أَمْسِ في البَيْتِ، وَلَمْ أَجِدْكَ.
dialogue.tr: zurtuka amsi fil-bayt, wa lam ajidka
dialogue.en: I visited you yesterday at home, and I did not find you.
dialogue.ur: Maine kal ghar par aap se milne ki koshish ki, aur aap nahi mile.

dialogue.ar: ذَهَبْتُ مَعَ ابْني طارِق إِلى الجامِعَةِ؛ لِيُقَدِّمَ أَوْراقَهُ إِلى كُلِّيَّةِ الهَنْدَسَة.
dialogue.tr: dhahabtu maʿa ibnī Ṭāriq ilā l-jāmiʿa; li-yuqaddima awrāqahu ilā kulliyyati l-handasa
dialogue.en: I went with my son Tariq to the university so he could submit his papers to the College of Engineering.
dialogue.ur: Main apne bete Tariq ke saath jamia gaya, taake woh Engineering college mein kaagzaat jama karwaye.

dialogue.ar: سَيُقْبَلُ طارِقٌ في كُلِّيَّةِ الهَنْدَسَة – إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ – فَتَقْديرُهُ «مُمْتاز» في الثَّانَوِيَّة.
dialogue.tr: sa-yuqbalu Ṭāriq fī kulliyyati l-handasa – in shāʾa llāh – fa-taqdīruhu mumtāz fī th-thānawiyya
dialogue.en: Tariq will be accepted in the College of Engineering, God willing, for his grade in high school is excellent.
dialogue.ur: Tariq ko in sha Allah Engineering college mein qubool kar liya jayega, kyunke secondary mein uska grade mumtaz hai.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ قَدَّمَ ابْنُكَ أَوْراقَهُ إِلى كُلِّيَّةِ الطِّبّ؟
dialogue.tr: hal qaddama ibnuka awrāqahu ilā kulliyyati ṭ-ṭibb?
dialogue.en: Did your son submit his papers to the College of Medicine?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap ke bete ne Medical college mein kaagzaat jama karwaye?

dialogue.ar: لا، لَمْ يُقَدِّمْ أَوْراقَهُ إِلى كُلِّيَّةِ الطِّبّ؛ إِنَّهُ لا يَرْغَبُ في دِراسَةِ الطِّبّ.
dialogue.tr: lā, lam yuqaddim awrāqahu ilā kulliyyati ṭ-ṭibb; innahu lā yarghabu fī dirāsati ṭ-ṭibb
dialogue.en: No, he did not submit his papers to the College of Medicine; he does not want to study medicine.
dialogue.ur: Nahi, usne Medical college mein kaagzaat jama nahi karwaye; woh medicine parhna nahi chahta.

dialogue.ar: لا يَرْغَبُ في دِراسَةِ الطِّبّ! لَقَدْ حَصَلَ عَلى تَقْديرِ «مُمْتاز» في العُلومِ الطَّبيعِيَّة.
dialogue.tr: lā yarghabu fī dirāsati ṭ-ṭibb! laqad ḥaṣala ʿalā taqdīr mumtāz fil-ʿulūmi ṭ-ṭabīʿiyya
dialogue.en: He does not want to study medicine! He got an excellent grade in the natural sciences.
dialogue.ur: Woh medicine nahi parhna chahta! Usne science mein mumtaz grade liya hai.

dialogue.ar: هَذا صَحيح، وَلَكِنَّهُ يَرْغَبُ في الِالْتِحاقِ بِقِسْمِ اللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّة. أَحْمَدُ يُحِبُّ دِراسَةَ اللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّة.
dialogue.tr: hādhā ṣaḥīḥ, wa lākinnahu yarghabu fil-iltiḥāqi bi-qismi l-lugha l-ʿarabiyya. Aḥmad yuḥibbu dirāsata l-lugha l-ʿarabiyya
dialogue.en: That is true, but he wants to join the Arabic Language Department. Ahmad loves studying Arabic.
dialogue.ur: Yeh sahi hai, lekin woh Arabic department mein daakhila lena chahta hai. Ahmad Arabic parhna pasand karta hai.

dialogue.ar: لا عَجَبَ في ذَلِك؛ فَالعَرَبِيَّةُ لُغَةُ القُرْآنِ الكَريم، وَلَكِنْ هَلْ سَيُقْبَلُ في قِسْمِ اللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّة؟
dialogue.tr: lā ʿajaba fī dhālik; fal-ʿarabiyyatu lughatu l-Qurʾāni l-karīm, wa lākin hal sa-yuqbalu fī qismi l-lugha l-ʿarabiyya?
dialogue.en: No wonder; Arabic is the language of the Noble Quran. But will he be accepted in the Arabic Language Department?
dialogue.ur: Is mein koi hairat nahi; Arabic Quran-e-Kareem ki zubaan hai. Lekin kya use Arabic department mein qubool kiya jayega?

dialogue.ar: قابَلْتُ عَميدَ كُلِّيَّةِ الآداب، وَدَرَسَ أَوْراقَهُ، وَوافَقَ عَلى قَبولِه.
dialogue.tr: qābaltu ʿamīda kulliyyati l-ādāb, wa darasa awrāqahu, wa wāfaqa ʿalā qabūlih
dialogue.en: I met the dean of the College of Arts, he studied his papers and agreed to accept him.
dialogue.ur: Maine Arts college ke dean se mulaqat ki, unhon ne kaagzaat dekhe aur qubool karne par razi ho gaye.

dialogue.ar: وَفَّقَهُ اللهُ في دِراسَةِ اللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّة.
dialogue.tr: waffaqahu llāhu fī dirāsati l-lugha l-ʿarabiyya
dialogue.en: May Allah grant him success in studying the Arabic language.
dialogue.ur: Allah use Arabic parhne mein kamyabi ata farmaye.

dialogue.ar: شُكْراً لَكَ، وَوَفَّقَ اللهُ ابْنَكَ في دِراسَةِ الهَنْدَسَةِ أَيْضاً.
dialogue.tr: shukran laka, wa waffaqa llāhu ibnaka fī dirāsati l-handasa ayḍan
dialogue.en: Thank you, and may Allah grant your son success in studying engineering too.
dialogue.ur: Shukriya, aur Allah aap ke bete ko Engineering parhne mein bhi kamyabi de.

q.en: What did Salim's son Tariq go to the university to do?
q.ur: Salim ka beta Tariq jamia kis kaam ke liye gaya?
q.ar: لِماذا ذَهَبَ طارِقٌ ابْنُ سالِمٍ إِلى الجامِعَةِ؟

q.en: Which college will accept Tariq, in sha Allah?
q.ur: Tariq ko in sha Allah kaun si kulliyah qubool karegi?
q.ar: أَيُّ كُلِّيَّةٍ سَتَقْبَلُ طارِقاً إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ؟

q.en: What does Ahmad like to study?
q.ur: Ahmad kya parhna pasand karta hai?

q.en: What does «لَمْ أَجِدْكَ» mean?
q.ur: «لَمْ أَجِدْكَ» ka matlab kya hai?

options: I did not find you / Maine aap ko nahi paya
I found you / Maine aap ko paya
I will find you / Main aap ko paunga

intro.en: The shadda (ّ) is a sign over a letter that means the letter is doubled (said twice, strongly). Compare «كَلِمَ» and «كَلَّمَ». Listen and practise the pairs.
intro.ur: Shadda (ّ) harf ke upar ki alamat hai jo batati hai ke harf do baar parha jayega (mazboot). Misal: «كَلِمَ» aur «كَلَّمَ». Sunein aur dohraayein.
intro.ar: الشَّدَّةُ (ّ) عَلامَةٌ فَوْقَ الحَرْفِ تَدُلُّ عَلى أَنَّهُ مُضاعَفٌ، يُنْطَقُ مَرَّتَيْنِ بِقُوَّةٍ. قارِنْ بَيْنَ «كَلِمَ» وَ«كَلَّمَ». اِسْتَمِعْ وَتَدَرَّبْ عَلى الأَزْواجِ.

vocab.ur: shadda, harf do baar parhne ki alamat

q.en: What does the shadda show?
q.ur: Shadda kya batati hai?

options: The letter is doubled / Harf do baar parha jata hai
The letter is silent / Harf khamosh hai
The vowel is long / Harakat lambi hai
The word is a question / Lafz sawal hai

q.en: Which word has a shadda?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein shadda hai?

q.en: Where is the shadda written?
q.ur: Shadda kahan likhi jaati hai?

options: Above the letter / Harf ke upar
Below the letter / Harf ke neeche
After the word / Lafz ke baad
Before the word / Lafz se pehle

q.en: Which word is «دَرَسَ» with a shadda?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz «دَرَسَ» ka shadda wala roop hai?

title.ur: Fe'l ka jazm: lam aur lā

intro.en: The present verb is put in the jussive (majzūm) after words like «لَمْ» (did not) and «لا» (don't). A sign of this is a sukoon on the last letter, e.g. «لَمْ يَقْرَأْ». Example: «لا تَلْعَبْ» – don't play.
intro.ur: Fe'l-e-mudari ko «لَمْ» (nahi) aur «لا» (mat) ke baad jazm aata hai. Iski ek nishani aakhri harf par sukoon hai, jaise «لَمْ يَقْرَأْ». Misal: «لا تَلْعَبْ» – mat khelo.
intro.ar: يُجْزَمُ الفِعْلُ المُضارِعُ بَعْدَ أَدَواتٍ مِثْلِ «لَمْ» (لِنَفْيِ الماضي) وَ«لا» (لِلنَّهْيِ). وَمِنْ عَلاماتِ الجَزْمِ السُّكونُ عَلى الحَرْفِ الأَخيرِ، مِثْلَ «لَمْ يَقْرَأْ». مِثالٌ: «لا تَلْعَبْ».

q.en: What do «لَمْ» and «لا» (prohibition) do to the present verb?
q.ur: «لَمْ» aur «لا» (mana karne wala) fe'l-e-mudari par kya asar karte hain?
q.ar: ماذا تَفْعَلُ «لَمْ» وَ«لا» النّاهِيَةُ بِالفِعْلِ المُضارِعِ؟

options: They make it jussive (majzūm) / Use jazm dete hain
They make it past tense / Use maazi bana dete hain
They make it a noun / Use ism bana dete hain
They delete it / Use hata dete hain

q.en: A sign of the jussive present verb is:
q.ur: Fe'l-e-mudari ke majzoom hone ki ek nishani:

options: A sukoon on the last letter / Aakhri harf par sukoon
A shadda on the first letter / Pehle harf par shadda

q.en: Which means «Do not play with the ball»?
q.ur: «Gend se mat khelo» kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ تَعْني النَّهْيَ عَنِ اللَّعِبِ بِالكُرَةِ؟

q.en: What does «لَمْ يَتَكَلَّمْ» mean?
q.ur: «لَمْ يَتَكَلَّمْ» ka matlab?

options: He did not speak / Usne baat nahi ki
He speaks / Woh baat karta hai
Do not speak / Baat mat karo
He will speak / Woh baat karega

intro.en: Practise asking and answering «لِماذا؟» (why?) and the verb «رَغِبَ في» (to want, be keen on). Notice that «يَرْغَبُ» takes «في» and then «أَنْ» + verb.
intro.ur: «لِماذا؟» (kyun?) poochna aur jawab dena mashq karein, aur fe'l «رَغِبَ في» (chahna). Dhyan dein: «يَرْغَبُ في أَنْ» ke baad fe'l aata hai.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى السُّؤالِ وَالجَوابِ بِـ«لِماذا؟»، وَعَلى الفِعْلِ «رَغِبَ في» (أَحَبَّ وَأَرادَ). لاحِظْ أَنَّ «يَرْغَبُ» يَأْتي بَعْدَهُ «في» ثُمَّ «أَنْ» وَفِعْلٌ.

q.en: What does «لِماذا» mean?
q.ur: «لِماذا» ka matlab?

q.en: «أَرْغَبُ في دِراسَةِ الطِّبّ» means:
q.ur: «أَرْغَبُ في دِراسَةِ الطِّبّ» ka matlab:

options: I want to study medicine / Main medicine parhna chahta hoon
I teach medicine / Main medicine parhata hoon
I left medicine / Maine medicine chhod di
I sell medicine / Main dawai bechta hoon

q.en: Which phrase asks «Why do we study Arabic?»
q.ur: «Hum Arabic kyun parhte hain?» kaun sa jumla hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عِبارَةٍ تَسْأَلُ عَنْ سَبَبِ دِراسَةِ اللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ؟

q.en: Which phrase asks «Why do we memorise the Noble Quran?»
q.ur: «Hum Quran kyun hifz karte hain?» kaun sa jumla hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عِبارَةٍ تَسْأَلُ عَنْ سَبَبِ حِفْظِ القُرْآنِ الكَريمِ؟

intro.en: A reading passage comparing education in the past and today: few schools then, many schools now, and a change in the teacher's and student's goals.
intro.ur: Ek parhne ka matan jo maazi aur aaj ki taleem ka muqabla karta hai: pehle school kam the, ab bohat hain, aur ustaad aur talib-e-ilm ke maqasid badal gaye.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلْقِراءَةِ يُقارِنُ بَيْنَ التَّعْليمِ قَديماً وَاليَوْمَ: كانَتِ المَدارِسُ قَليلَةً وَاليَوْمَ كَثيرَةٌ، وَتَغَيَّرَتْ أَهْدافُ المُعَلِّمِ وَالطّالِبِ.

dialogue.ar: هُناكَ اخْتِلافاتٌ كَثيرَةٌ بَيْنَ التَّعْليمِ في الماضي وَالتَّعْليمِ في الحاضِر.
dialogue.tr: hunāka ikhtilāfātun kathīra bayna t-taʿlīmi fil-māḍī wa t-taʿlīmi fil-ḥāḍir
dialogue.en: There are many differences between education in the past and education in the present.
dialogue.ur: Maazi aur haal ki taleem mein bohat se farq hain.

dialogue.ar: مِنْ تِلْكَ الِاخْتِلافات، أَنَّ فُرَصَ التَّعْليمِ كانَتْ قَليلَةً في الماضي.
dialogue.tr: min tilka l-ikhtilāfāt, anna furaṣa t-taʿlīmi kānat qalīlatan fil-māḍī
dialogue.en: Among those differences: opportunities for education were few in the past.
dialogue.ur: In farqon mein se: maazi mein taleem ke mauqe kam the.

dialogue.ar: كانَ يَلْتَحِقُ بِالمَدارِسِ طُلّابٌ قَليلونَ، هُمْ في الغالِبِ أَبْناءُ الأَغْنِياءِ وَسُكّانُ المُدُن.
dialogue.tr: kāna yaltaḥiqu bil-madāris ṭullābun qalīlūn, hum fil-ghālibi abnāʾu l-aghniyāʾi wa sukkānu l-mudun
dialogue.en: Few students joined the schools; they were mostly the sons of the rich and city dwellers.
dialogue.ur: Madrason mein thode talib-e-ilm jaate the, aksar ameeron ke bete aur shehr ke log.

dialogue.ar: أَمَّا اليَوْمَ، فَقَدْ أَصْبَحَ التَّعْليمُ حَقّاً لِكُلِّ مُواطِن.
dialogue.tr: ammā l-yawm, faqad aṣbaḥa t-taʿlīmu ḥaqqan li-kulli muwāṭin
dialogue.en: Today, education has become a right for every citizen.
dialogue.ur: Aaj taleem har shehri ka haq ban chuki hai.

dialogue.ar: وَشاعَ القَوْلُ: «التَّعْليمُ كَالماءِ وَالهَواء».
dialogue.tr: wa shāʿa l-qawl: at-taʿlīmu kal-māʾi wal-hawāʾ
dialogue.en: The saying spread: "Education is like water and air."
dialogue.ur: Yeh kahawat mash'hoor hui: "Taleem paani aur hawa ki tarah hai."

dialogue.ar: كانَ طُلّابُ العِلْمِ في الماضي يُسافِرونَ مِنْ بَلَدٍ إِلى بَلَدٍ لِطَلَبِ العِلْم، وَكانوا يَرْكَبونَ الجِمال أَيّاماً وَأَشْهُراً.
dialogue.tr: kāna ṭullābu l-ʿilm fil-māḍī yusāfirūna min baladin ilā balad li-ṭalabi l-ʿilm, wa kānū yarkabūna l-jimāla ayyāman wa ashhura
dialogue.en: Students of knowledge in the past travelled from country to country to seek knowledge, riding camels for days and months.
dialogue.ur: Maazi mein talib-e-ilm ilm ki talash mein mulk mulk safar karte, aur dinon mahinon oonton par sawar rehte.

dialogue.ar: أَمَّا اليَوْمَ فَالمَدارِسُ وَالجامِعاتُ كَثيرَةٌ في كُلِّ مَدينَةٍ وَقَرْيَةٍ تَقْريباً.
dialogue.tr: ammā l-yawm fal-madāris wal-jāmiʿāt kathīra fī kulli madīnatin wa qaryatin taqrīban
dialogue.en: Today schools and universities are many, in almost every city and village.
dialogue.ur: Aaj taqreeban har shehr aur gaon mein school aur jamiat bohat hain.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْ ناحِيَةٍ أُخْرى، يَسْتَطيعُ الطّالِبُ أَنْ يَتَعَلَّمَ وَهُوَ في بَيْتِهِ عَنْ طَريقِ الشَّبَكَةِ الدَّوْلِيَّة.
dialogue.tr: wa min nāḥiyatin ukhrā, yastaṭīʿu ṭ-ṭālibu an yataʿallama wa huwa fī baytihi ʿan ṭarīqi sh-shabakati d-dawliyya
dialogue.en: On the other hand, a student can learn at home through the internet.
dialogue.ur: Doosri taraf, talib-e-ilm ghar baithe internet ke zariye seekh sakta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ هَدَفُ الطّالِبِ طَلَبَ العِلْم. أَمَّا اليَوْمَ فَقَدِ اخْتَلَفَ الأَمْر؛ فَالمُعَلِّمُ يَطْلُبُ كَثيراً مِنَ الأَجْر، وَالطّالِبُ يُفَكِّرُ في الشَّهادَةِ قَبْلَ العِلْم؛ لِأَنَّها وَسيلَةٌ إِلى العَمَل.
dialogue.tr: wa kāna hadafu ṭ-ṭālibi ṭalaba l-ʿilm. ammā l-yawm faqadi khtalafa l-amr; fal-muʿallimu yaṭlubu kathīran mina l-ajr, waṭ-ṭālibu yufakkiru fish-shahādati qabla l-ʿilm; li-annahā wasīlatun ilā l-ʿamal
dialogue.en: The student's aim was seeking knowledge. Today it is different: the teacher asks for much pay, and the student thinks of the certificate before knowledge, because it is a means to work.
dialogue.ur: Talib-e-ilm ka maqsad ilm hasil karna tha. Aaj baat badal gayi hai: ustaad bohat ujrat maangta hai aur talib-e-ilm ilm se pehle sanad ke baare mein sochta hai, kyunke woh kaam ka zariya hai.

q.en: In the past, who usually attended the few schools?
q.ur: Maazi mein kam madrason mein aam taur par kaun jaata tha?
q.ar: في الماضي، مَنْ كانَ يَدْرُسُ في المَدارِسِ القَليلَةِ غالِباً؟

options: Sons of the rich and city dwellers / Ameeron ke bete aur shehr ke log

q.en: What has education become today, according to the text?
q.ur: Matan ke mutabiq aaj taleem kya ban gayi hai?
q.ar: ماذا صارَ التَّعْليمُ اليَوْمَ بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ؟

options: The right of every citizen / Har shehri ka haq

q.en: Why did the teacher in the past not ask for a wage?
q.ur: Maazi mein ustaad ujrat kyun nahi maangta tha?
q.ar: لِماذا لَمْ يَطْلُبِ المُعَلِّمُ في الماضي أَجْراً؟

options: He sought the reward from Allah / Woh Allah se ajar chahta tha
He was rich / Woh ameer tha
He was lazy / Woh susst tha
There were no students / Talib-e-ilm nahi the

q.en: How did students travel in the past?
q.ur: Maazi mein talib-e-ilm kaise safar karte the?
q.ar: كَيْفَ كانَ الطُّلّابُ يُسافِرونَ في الماضي؟

options: On camels, for days and months / Oonton par, dinon aur mahinon

intro.en: When one noun is added to another they become like one thing. The first is the «مُضاف» and the second is the «مُضاف إِلَيْه», which is always in the genitive (majrūr). Example: «طَلَبُ العِلْمِ» – seeking of knowledge.
intro.ur: Jab ek ism doosre ism ki taraf mansoob ho to dono ek cheez ki tarah ho jaate hain. Pehle ko «مُضاف» aur doosre ko «مُضاف إِلَيْه» kehte hain, aur mudaf ilaih hamesha majroor hota hai. Misal: «طَلَبُ العِلْمِ» – ilm ki talab.
intro.ar: إِذا أُضيفَ اسْمٌ إِلى اسْمٍ صارا كَالشَّيْءِ الواحِدِ. الأَوَّلُ «مُضاف» وَالثّاني «مُضاف إِلَيْه»، وَهُوَ مَجْرورٌ دائِماً. مِثالٌ: «طَلَبُ العِلْمِ».

vocab.en: the first noun in an idafa
the second noun in an idafa

q.en: The second noun in an idafa is called:
q.ur: Idafa mein doosre ism ko kya kehte hain?
q.ar: ماذا نُسَمّي الاسْمَ الثّانِيَ في الإِضافَةِ؟

q.en: The mudaf ilaih is always:
q.ur: Mudaf ilaih hamesha hota hai:

q.en: Which phrase is an idafa?
q.ur: Kaun sa idafa hai?

q.en: What do we call the people who live in cities?
q.ur: Shehron mein rehne walon ko kya kehte hain?
q.ar: ماذا نُسَمّي النّاسَ الَّذينَ يَسْكُنونَ في المُدُنِ؟

q.en: Which phrase means «students of the university»?
q.ur: «Jamia ke talaba» kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عِبارَةٍ تَعْني الَّذينَ يَدْرُسونَ في الجامِعَةِ؟

intro.en: A dialogue between Fatima and Aisha about the great Muslim civilisation, its progress in science and why Muslims fell behind. Notice that the first revealed word of the Quran is «اِقْرَأْ» (read).
intro.ur: Fatima aur Aisha ki baat-cheet musalmanon ki azeem tehzeeb, science mein tarraqi aur unke peeche reh jane ke baare mein. Dhyan dein: Quran ka pehla nazil hone wala lafz «اِقْرَأْ» (parho) hai.
intro.ar: حِوارٌ بَيْنَ فاطِمَةَ وَعائِشَةَ عَنْ حَضارَةِ المُسْلِمينَ الكَبيرَةِ وَتَقَدُّمِها في العُلومِ وَسَبَبِ تَأَخُّرِ المُسْلِمينَ. لاحِظْ أَنَّ أَوَّلَ كَلِمَةٍ نَزَلَتْ مِنَ القُرْآنِ هِيَ «اِقْرَأْ».

dialogue.ar: ماذا تَقْرَئينَ – يا عائِشَة – هَذِهِ الأَيّام؟
dialogue.tr: mādhā taqraʾīn – yā ʿĀʾisha – hādhihi l-ayyām?
dialogue.en: What are you reading, Aisha, these days?
dialogue.ur: Aisha, in dinon aap kya parh rahi hain?

dialogue.ar: أَقْرَأُ كُتُباً عَنْ حَضارَةِ المُسْلِمين. كانَتْ حَضارَةً عَظيمَةً تَقَدَّمَتْ في الطِّبِّ وَالصَّيْدَلَةِ وَالعُلومِ وَالرِّياضِيّاتِ وَالجُغْرافْيا وَالفَلَكِ وَالعُلومِ الإِنْسانِيَّة.
dialogue.tr: aqraʾu kutuban ʿan ḥaḍārati l-muslimīn. kānat ḥaḍāratan ʿaẓīmatan taqaddamat fiṭ-ṭibb waṣ-ṣaydala wal-ʿulūm war-riyāḍiyyāt wal-jughrāfiyā wal-falak wal-ʿulūmi l-insāniyya
dialogue.en: I read books about the Muslims' civilisation. It was a great civilisation that advanced in medicine, pharmacy, sciences, mathematics, geography, astronomy and the humanities.
dialogue.ur: Main musalmanon ki tehzeeb par kitaabein parh rahi hoon. Woh ek azeem tehzeeb thi jis ne tibb, saidla, uloom, riyazi, jughrafiya, falakiyat aur insani uloom mein tarraqi ki.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ تَأَثَّرَتْ أُورُوبّا بِحَضارَةِ المُسْلِمين؟
dialogue.tr: hal ta'aththarat Ūrūbbā bi-ḥaḍārati l-muslimīn?
dialogue.en: Was Europe influenced by the Muslims' civilisation?
dialogue.ur: Kya Europe musalmanon ki tehzeeb se mutassir hua?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، تَأَثَّرَتْ بِها كَثيراً، فَقَدِ اتَّصَلَ عُلَماءُ أُورُوبّا بِعُلَماءِ المُسْلِمين، وَأَخَذوا عَنْهُمُ العِلْم، وَتَرْجَموا كُتُبَهُمْ، وَدَرَسوها في جامِعاتِهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, ta'aththarat bihā kathīran, faqadi ttaṣala ʿulamāʾu Ūrūbbā bi-ʿulamāʾi l-muslimīn, wa akhadhū ʿanhumu l-ʿilm, wa tarjamū kutubahum, wa darasūhā fī jāmiʿātihim
dialogue.en: Yes, it was greatly influenced; European scholars contacted Muslim scholars, took knowledge from them, translated their books and studied them in their universities.
dialogue.ur: Haan, bohat mutassir hua; Europe ke ulama ne musalman ulama se rabta kiya, un se ilm liya, unki kitaabon ka tarjuma kiya aur apni jamiat mein parhin.

dialogue.ar: وَلَكِنْ، لِماذا تَأَخَّرَ المُسْلِمونَ بَعْدَ ذَلِك؟
dialogue.tr: wa lākin, limādhā ta'akhkhara l-muslimūna baʿda dhālik?
dialogue.en: But why did the Muslims fall behind after that?
dialogue.ur: Lekin phir musalman uske baad peeche kyun reh gaye?

dialogue.ar: تَأَخَّروا؛ لِأَنَّهُمْ تَرَكوا العِلْم، وَابْتَعَدوا عَنِ الدّين.
dialogue.tr: ta'akhkharū; li-annahum tarakū l-ʿilm, wa btaʿadū ʿani d-dīn
dialogue.en: They fell behind because they left knowledge and moved away from the religion.
dialogue.ur: Woh peeche reh gaye, kyunke unhon ne ilm chhod diya aur deen se door ho gaye.

dialogue.ar: كَيْفَ يَتْرُكونَ العِلْم، وَالإِسْلامُ يَدْعو إِلَيْه؟!
dialogue.tr: kayfa yatrukūna l-ʿilm, wal-islāmu yadʿū ilayh?!
dialogue.en: How can they leave knowledge when Islam calls to it?!
dialogue.ur: Woh ilm kaise chhod dete hain, jabke Islam us ki dawat deta hai?!

dialogue.ar: أَحْسَنْتِ، فَأَوَّلُ كَلِمَةٍ نَزَلَتْ مِنَ القُرْآنِ، هِيَ: اِقْرَأْ.
dialogue.tr: aḥsant, fa-awwalu kalimatin nazalat mina l-Qurʾān, hiya: iqraʾ
dialogue.en: Well said! The first word revealed of the Quran is: "Read".
dialogue.ur: Aap ne theek kaha! Quran ka pehla nazil hone wala lafz hai: "parho".

dialogue.ar: وَدَعا الرَّسولُ ﷺ المُسْلِمينَ في كَثيرٍ مِنْ أَحاديثِهِ لِطَلَبِ العِلْم، كَقَوْلِه: «طَلَبُ العِلْمِ فَريضَةٌ عَلى كُلِّ مُسْلِم».
dialogue.tr: wa daʿā r-rasūlu ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam l-muslimīna fī kathīrin min aḥādīthihi li-ṭalabi l-ʿilm, ka-qawlih: ṭalabu l-ʿilmi farīḍatun ʿalā kulli muslim
dialogue.en: The Messenger ﷺ called Muslims in many of his hadiths to seek knowledge, such as his saying: "Seeking knowledge is an obligation on every Muslim."
dialogue.ur: Rasool ﷺ ne apni bohat si ahadees mein musalmanon ko ilm ki talab ki dawat di, jaise unka farmaan: "Ilm talab karna har musalman par farz hai."

dialogue.ar: الحَمْدُ لله، فَقَدْ رَجَعَ المُسْلِمونَ مَرَّةً أُخْرى إِلى طَلَبِ العِلْم؛ فَها هِيَ المَدارِسُ وَالجامِعاتُ تَنْتَشِرُ في جَميعِ بِلادِ المُسْلِمين.
dialogue.tr: al-ḥamdu lillāh, faqad rajaʿa l-muslimūna marratan ukhrā ilā ṭalabi l-ʿilm; fa-hā hiya l-madārisu wal-jāmiʿātu tantashiru fī jamīʿi bilādi l-muslimīn
dialogue.en: Praise be to Allah, Muslims have returned to seeking knowledge; schools and universities are spreading in all Muslim lands.
dialogue.ur: Alhamdulillah, musalman dobara ilm ki talab ki taraf laut aaye hain; madaaris aur jamiaat tamam musalman mulkon mein phail rahi hain.

dialogue.ar: وَعَلى كُلِّ مُسْلِم، رَجُلاً كانَ أَوْ امْرَأَةً، أَنْ يَطْلُبَ العِلْمَ طَوالَ حَياتِهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa ʿalā kulli muslim, rajulan kāna aw imraʾatan, an yaṭluba l-ʿilma ṭawāla ḥayātih
dialogue.en: And every Muslim, man or woman, must seek knowledge throughout his life.
dialogue.ur: Aur har musalman par, mard ho ya aurat, lazim hai ke zindagi bhar ilm talab kare.

q.en: What is the first word revealed of the Quran, as in the dialogue?
q.ur: Dialogue ke mutabiq Quran ka pehla nazil hone wala lafz kaun sa hai?
q.ar: ما أَوَّلُ كَلِمَةٍ نَزَلَتْ مِنَ القُرْآنِ كَما في الحِوارِ؟

q.en: Why did Muslims fall behind, according to Aisha?
q.ur: Aisha ke mutabiq musalman peeche kyun reh gaye?

options: They left knowledge and moved away from the religion / Unhon ne ilm chhoda aur deen se door ho gaye
They had no schools / Unke paas school nahi the
They had no books / Unke paas kitaabein nahi thin
They travelled too much / Unhon ne zyada safar kiya

q.en: Which sciences did Muslims advance in?
q.ur: Musalmanon ne kin uloom mein tarraqi ki?

options: Medicine, pharmacy and mathematics / Tibb, saidla aur riyazi

q.en: Which hadith is quoted?
q.ur: Kaun si hadees naqal ki gayi?

options: طَلَبُ العِلْمِ فَريضَةٌ عَلى كُلِّ مُسْلِم

intro.en: A noun has three kinds: singular (one), dual (two) and plural (more than two). Example: «مُسْلِمٌ – مُسْلِمانِ – مُسْلِمونَ» (one Muslim, two Muslims, Muslims).
intro.ur: Ism ki teen qismein hain: mufrad (ek), muthanna (do) aur jam' (do se zyada). Misal: «مُسْلِمٌ – مُسْلِمانِ – مُسْلِمونَ» (ek musalman, do musalman, kayi musalman).
intro.ar: لِلاسْمِ ثَلاثَةُ أَحْوالٍ: المُفْرَدُ (واحِدٌ) وَالمُثَنّى (اِثْنانِ) وَالجَمْعُ (أَكْثَرُ مِنِ اثْنَيْنِ). مِثالٌ: مُسْلِمٌ - مُسْلِمانِ - مُسْلِمونَ.

q.en: A dual noun refers to:
q.ur: Muthanna kis ki taraf ishara karta hai?

options: More than two / Do se zyada

q.en: What is the dual of «طَبيبَة» (female doctor)?
q.ur: «طَبيبَة» ka muthanna?

q.en: What is the plural of «جامِعَة»?
q.ur: «جامِعَة» ki jama?

q.en: Which word is singular?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz mufrad hai?

title.en: Listening and speaking: the Muslims' civilisation

intro.en: Listen again to the dialogue about the Muslims' civilisation, choose the right answers, then discuss the statements with your classmates.
intro.ur: Musalmanon ki tehzeeb wala mukaalma dobara sunein, sahi jawab chunein, phir saathiyon ke saath un jumlon par baat karein.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ مَرَّةً أُخْرى إِلى الحِوارِ عَنْ حَضارَةِ المُسْلِمينَ، وَاخْتَرِ الإِجاباتِ الصَّحيحَةَ، ثُمَّ ناقِشْ العِباراتِ مَعَ زُمَلائِكَ.

q.en: According to the dialogue, which was the first word revealed of the Quran?
q.ur: Dialogue ke mutabiq Quran ka pehla nazil hone wala lafz kaun sa tha?
q.ar: بِحَسَبِ الحِوارِ، ما أَوَّلُ كَلِمَةٍ نَزَلَتْ مِنَ القُرْآنِ؟

q.en: Which sentence fits the dialogue?
q.ur: Dialogue se kaun sa jumla milta hai?

q.en: What does «تَأَخَّرَ المُسْلِمونَ» mean?
q.ur: «تَأَخَّرَ المُسْلِمونَ» ka matlab?

options: The Muslims fell behind / Musalman peeche reh gaye
The Muslims travelled / Musalman ne safar kiya
The Muslims won / Musalman jeet gaye
The Muslims slept / Musalman so gaye

q.en: Which is a good title for the discussion?
q.ur: Behas ka achha unwan kaun sa hai?

intro.en: A passage about the stages of education in the Arab countries: primary, middle, secondary and university, then higher studies, and two kinds of education, government and private.
intro.ur: Arab mulkon mein taleem ke marahil ka matan: ibtidai, mutawassit, sanvi aur jamiai, phir aala taleem, aur taleem ki do qismein: sarkari aur nijji.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ عَنْ مَراحِلِ التَّعْليمِ في البِلادِ العَرَبِيَّةِ: الابْتِدائِيَّةُ وَالمُتَوَسِّطَةُ وَالثّانَوِيَّةُ وَالجامِعِيَّةُ، ثُمَّ الدِّراساتُ العُلْيا، وَنَوْعا التَّعْليمِ: الحُكومِيُّ وَالخاصُّ.

dialogue.ar: لِلتَّعْليمِ مَراحِلُ مُخْتَلِفَة، يَمُرُّ بِها الطّالِبُ خِلالَ دِراسَتِه.
dialogue.tr: lit-taʿlīmi marāḥilu mukhtalifa, yamurru bihā ṭ-ṭālibu khilāla dirāsatih
dialogue.en: Education has different stages that a student goes through during his studies.
dialogue.ur: Taleem ke mukhtalif marahil hain jin se talib-e-ilm apni parhai ke dauran guzarta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَتَتَكَوَّنُ مَراحِلُ التَّعْليمِ في كَثيرٍ مِنَ الدُّوَلِ العَرَبِيَّةِ مِنْ أَرْبَعِ مَراحِل: المَرْحَلَةُ الِابْتِدائِيَّة، فَالمُتَوَسِّطَة، فَالثّانَوِيَّة، ثُمَّ الجامِعِيَّة.
dialogue.tr: wa tatakawwanu marāḥilu t-taʿlīmi fī kathīrin mina d-duwali l-ʿarabiyya min arbaʿi marāḥil: al-marḥalatu l-ibtidāʾiyya, fal-mutawassiṭa, fath-thānawiyya, thumma l-jāmiʿiyya
dialogue.en: In many Arab countries education has four stages: primary, then middle, then secondary, then university.
dialogue.ur: Kayi Arab mulkon mein taleem chaar marahil par mushtamil hai: ibtidai, phir mutawassit, phir sanvi, phir jamiai.

dialogue.ar: يَلْتَحِقُ التَّلامیذُ بِالمَدْرَسَةِ الِابْتِدائِيَّةِ – عادَةً – في السّادِسَةِ مِنْ أَعْمارِهِم.
dialogue.tr: yaltaḥiqu t-talāmīdhu bil-madrasati l-ibtidāʾiyya – ʿādatan – fis-sādisati min aʿmārihim
dialogue.en: Pupils usually join the primary school at the age of six.
dialogue.ur: Bache aam taur par chhe saal ki umar mein ibtidai school mein daakhil hote hain.

dialogue.ar: وَتَبْلُغُ سَنَواتُ الدِّراسَةِ في المَرْحَلَةِ الِابْتِدائِيَّةِ سِتَّ سَنَوات، وَفي المُتَوَسِّطَةِ ثَلاثَ سَنَوات.
dialogue.tr: wa tablughu sanawātu d-dirāsati fil-marḥalati l-ibtidāʾiyya sitta sanawāt, wa fil-mutawassiṭa thalātha sanawāt
dialogue.en: The years of study in the primary stage are six, and in the middle stage three.
dialogue.ur: Ibtidai marhale mein parhai ke chhe saal hain aur mutawassit mein teen saal.

dialogue.ar: بَعْدَ أَنْ يُنْهِيَ الطّالِبُ المَرْحَلَةَ الثّانَوِيَّة، يَلْتَحِقُ بِالجامِعاتِ أَوِ المَعاهِد.
dialogue.tr: baʿda an yunhiya ṭ-ṭālibu l-marḥalata th-thānawiyya, yaltaḥiqu bil-jāmiʿāti awi l-maʿāhid
dialogue.en: After the student finishes the secondary stage, he joins universities or institutes.
dialogue.ur: Sanvi marhala mukammal karne ke baad talib-e-ilm jamiaat ya idaron mein daakhil hota hai.

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْدَ أَنْ يَحْصُلَ الطّالِبُ عَلى الشَّهادَةِ الجامِعِيَّةِ بِتَقْديرٍ جَيِّدٍ جِدّاً أَوْ مُمْتاز، يَلْتَحِقُ بِالدِّراساتِ العُلْيا لِلْحُصولِ عَلى شَهادَةِ الماجِسْتير، ثُمَّ شَهادَةِ الدُّكْتوراه.
dialogue.tr: wa baʿda an yaḥṣula ṭ-ṭālibu ʿalā sh-shahādati l-jāmiʿiyya bi-taqdīrin jayyidin jiddan aw mumtāz, yaltaḥiqu bid-dirāsāti l-ʿulyā lil-ḥuṣūli ʿalā shahādati l-mājistīr, thumma shahādati d-duktūrāh
dialogue.en: After he gets the university degree with a very good or excellent grade, he joins higher studies to obtain a master's, then a doctorate.
dialogue.ur: Jamiai sanad bohat achhe ya mumtaz grade se milne ke baad woh aala taleem mein daakhil hota hai taake masters aur phir doctorate hasil kare.

dialogue.ar: في البِلادِ العَرَبِيَّةِ نَوْعانِ مِنَ التَّعْليم، هُما: التَّعْليمُ الحُكومِيّ، وَتُشْرِفُ عَلَيْهِ الدَّوْلَة، وَالتَّعْليمُ الأَهْلِيّ، وَتُشْرِفُ عَلَيْهِ بَعْضُ الجَمْعِيّاتِ وَالأَفْراد.
dialogue.tr: fil-bilādi l-ʿarabiyya nawʿāni mina t-taʿlīm, humā: at-taʿlīmu l-ḥukūmī, wa tushrifu ʿalayhi d-dawla, wat-taʿlīmu l-ahlī, wa tushrifu ʿalayhi baʿḍu l-jamʿiyyāti wal-afrād
dialogue.en: In the Arab countries there are two kinds of education: government education, supervised by the state, and private education, supervised by some associations and individuals.
dialogue.ur: Arab mulkon mein taleem ki do qismein hain: sarkari taleem jis ki nigrani riyasat karti hai, aur nijji taleem jis ki nigrani kuch anjumanein aur afraad karte hain.

q.en: How many stages does education have in many Arab countries?
q.ur: Kayi Arab mulkon mein taleem ke kitne marahil hain?
q.ar: كَمْ مَرْحَلَةً لِلتَّعْليمِ في كَثيرٍ مِنَ البِلادِ العَرَبِيَّةِ؟

options: Four: primary, middle, secondary, university / Chaar

q.en: At what age do pupils usually join primary school?
q.ur: Bache aam taur par ibtidai school mein kis umar mein jaate hain?
q.ar: في أَيِّ سِنٍّ يَلْتَحِقُ التَّلاميذُ بِالمَدْرَسَةِ الابْتِدائِيَّةِ عادَةً؟

options: At six years / Chhe saal mein
At two years / Do saal mein
At ten years / Das saal mein

q.en: What comes after a good grade in the university certificate?
q.ur: Jamia ki sanad mein achhe grade ke baad kya aata hai?

intro.en: Seven endings attach to the past verb to show who did the action: تُ (I), تَ (you, m.), تِ (you, f.), نا (we), ا (the two), وا (they, m.), نَ (they, f.). Example: «كَتَبْتُ» – I wrote.
intro.ur: Maazi ke fe'l ke saath saat lahqe lagte hain jo batate hain kaam kis ne kiya: تُ (main), تَ (tum, mard), تِ (tum, aurat), نا (hum), ا (dono), وا (woh sab, mard), نَ (woh sab, aurtein). Misal: «كَتَبْتُ» – maine likha.
intro.ar: سَبْعُ نِهاياتٍ تَتَّصِلُ بِالفِعْلِ الماضي لِتُبَيِّنَ مَنْ فَعَلَ: تُ (أَنا)، تَ (أَنْتَ)، تِ (أَنْتِ)، نا (نَحْنُ)، ا (هُما)، وا (هُمْ)، نَ (هُنَّ). مِثالٌ: «كَتَبْتُ».

intro.en: Writing practice on education: use the two passages of this unit to write short compositions, such as «التَّعْليمُ في بَلَدي» (Education in my country) and «لِماذا أَتَعَلَّمُ اللُّغَةَ العَرَبِيَّة؟» (Why do I learn Arabic?).
intro.ur: Taleem par likhne ki mashq: is unit ke matan ki madad se chhoti tehreerein likhein, jaise «التَّعْليمُ في بَلَدي» (mere mulk mein taleem) aur «لِماذا أَتَعَلَّمُ اللُّغَةَ العَرَبِيَّة؟» (main Arabic kyun seekhta hoon?).
intro.ar: تَدَرُّبٌ عَلى الكِتابَةِ في مَوْضوعِ التَّعْليمِ: اِسْتَفِدْ مِنْ نَصَّيِ الوَحْدَةِ لِتَكْتُبَ مَوْضوعاتٍ قَصيرَةً مِثْلَ «التَّعْليمُ في بَلَدي» وَ«لِماذا أَتَعَلَّمُ اللُّغَةَ العَرَبِيَّةَ؟».

intro.en: Copy the Quran verse in the naskh script and practise spelling some words: «هَذا وَهَذِهِ، ذَلِكَ، هَكَذا، لَكِنْ، الرَّحْمَن». Notice that some words have a long sound that is not written with a letter.
intro.ur: Naskh khat mein Quran ki ayat naqal karein aur kuch alfaz ka imla mashq karein: «هَذا وَهَذِهِ، ذَلِكَ، هَكَذا، لَكِنْ، الرَّحْمَن». Dhyan dein: kuch alfaz mein lambi awaz hoti hai magar uske liye harf nahi likha jata.
intro.ar: اِنْسَخِ الآيَةَ بِخَطِّ النَّسْخِ وَتَدَرَّبْ عَلى إِمْلاءِ كَلِماتٍ: «هَذا وَهَذِهِ، ذَلِكَ، هَكَذا، لَكِنْ، الرَّحْمَن». لاحِظْ أَنَّ في بَعْضِ الكَلِماتِ صَوْتاً طَويلاً لا يُكْتَبُ بِحَرْفٍ.
